result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B shows all of its groups in the visible area (Notifications, Privacy, Units, Account), and its delete-account row is visibly separated and styled in red. A's screenshot is cut off after Privacy, so its temperature and delete settings can't be checked, and its cards have odd empty padding and a quiet-hours divider that looks clipped. A does better at signalling that changes save straight away, with its 'Changes save as soon as you make them' note and On/Off labels. Neither screenshot shows how quiet hours behave when reminders are turned off. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A is the narrower pick because its screenshot shows the full structure: Notifications, Privacy, Units, and a separate Account group with a red 'Delete account' row, all cleanly laid out. B's labels are friendlier, it shows On/Off text and says 'Changes save as soon as you make them', and it explains who sees the photos more clearly. However, B's screenshot is cut off before the temperature and deletion settings, and its quiet-hours legend sits awkwardly on the divider line with a lot of extra padding. Neither screenshot shows reminders turned off, so I couldn't check whether quiet hours dim when reminders are off.
